name: Yuka
title: yuka.io
shortDescription: Yuka is a mobile application designed to help users make healthier choices by scanning and analyzing product labels. It evaluates the quality of food and cosmetics, revealing any harmful ingredients such as endocrine disruptors or carcinogens. Ideal for health-conscious individuals, Yuka provides instant insights and recommendations for better alternatives, enhancing consumer awareness and promoting healthier lifestyles.
cons: May not cover all global products
